summary: Frees a block in a custom slab buddy allocator: coalesces with adjacent free blocks, updates the two-level 64-size-class occupancy bitmaps (allocator-level at this+0x0 and this+0x4, per-slab at result[v4+17] and result[v4+49]) and the doubly-linked per-class free lists, and when the slab and then its descriptor become fully empty, releases the slab virtual memory and frees the descriptor backing block.

operations.description: Compute slab index v4 = (a2 - slab base at this+0xC) >> 15; slabs are 0x8000 bytes.
Read block header at a2-4; if (header - 1) has bit 0 set the block is in use and the free/coalesce path is skipped.
Clamp the freed block size class v7 = (v20 >> 4) - 1 into the range 0..63.
If the next block header fields v6[1] and v6[2] are equal the next block is free, so coalesce it into the block being freed.

For coalesced blocks whose size class is below 32: clear the class bit in the per-slab lower bitmap result[v4+17]; when class occupancy drops to zero, clear the matching bit in the allocator-level lower bitmap at this+0x0.

For coalesced blocks whose size class is 32 or above: clear the class bit in the per-slab upper bitmap result[v4+49]; when class occupancy drops to zero, clear the matching bit in the allocator-level upper bitmap at this+0x4.
Unlink the free next block from its size class: write v6[2] + 4 = v6[1] and v6[1] + 8 = v6[2], then merge sizes v5 += v20.
If the previous block header v21 at a2-8 is free, merge left: v24 = v3 - v21 and merged size v22 = v21 + v5.
Clamp the merged block size class v13 = (v22 >> 4) - 1 into the range 0..63.

When the previous block was free and its class v14 differs from the merged class v13, clear the old class bit in the per-slab bitmap (result[v4+17] for classes below 32, result[v4+49] otherwise), clear the allocator-level bit at this+0x0 or this+0x4 when occupancy hits zero, and unlink the previous block (v24[2] + 4 = v24[1], v24[1] + 8 = v24[2]).

Link the merged block into the size class v13 free list: v3[1] = v17[1], v3[2] = v17, v17[1] = v3, v3[1] + 8 = v3, and write the merged size into both block headers (*v3 = v22 and *(v3 + v22 - 4) = v22).

Increment the class occupancy byte at result + v13 + 4; when it was zero, set the class bit in the per-slab bitmap (result[v4+17] below class 32, result[v4+49] otherwise) and the allocator-level bit at this+0x0 or this+0x4.
Decrement the per-slab live-block counter (*v19 at result[129 * v4 + 81]); when it reaches zero the whole 0x8000-byte slab is empty.

When the slab is empty and a descriptor exists at dword_8D48F4, release the slab's virtual memory via VirtualFree (address from dword_8D48EC shifted by 15, size 0x8000), mark the descriptor flags at desc+8, zero the slab slot at desc[16] + 4 * dword_8D48EC + 196, and decrement the descriptor's live-slab count at desc[16] + 67.
When the descriptor's live-slab count reaches zero, clear the descriptor in-use flag at desc + 4 (desc + 4 AND NOT 1).

When the descriptor is fully freed (desc + 8 == -1): VirtualFree the descriptor backing memory at desc + 12, HeapFree(hHeap, 0, desc + 16), call sub_58B130 to compact free-list entries (desc, desc + 20, lpMem + 20 * dword_8D48F8 - desc - 20), decrement dword_8D48F8, step a1 back by 5 words when it lies above the descriptor, and reset the allocation cursor dword_8D48F0 to lpMem.
Commit allocator metadata: set dword_8D48EC = v4 (current slab index) and dword_8D48F4 = a1 (current descriptor).

clean_pseudocode: if block header at ptr-4 has bit 0 set: return (block in use)
merge right neighbor if free; merge left neighbor if free
update per-slab class bitmaps result[slabIndex+17] and result[slabIndex+49] and allocator bitmaps this+0x0 / this+0x4
relink merged block into its size class free list
if slab live counter reaches zero: VirtualFree slab, update descriptor flags and counts
if descriptor fully free: VirtualFree backing memory, HeapFree descriptor block, sub_58B130 compact, update globals
unresolved: Exact descriptor sub-structure layout (flags at desc+4, desc+8, backing pointer at desc+12, arrays at desc+16 and desc+20) is inferred from pointer arithmetic only, not an authoritative struct definition.

The allocator-level bitmap is split between this+0x0 (classes 0-31) and this+0x4 (classes 32-63); per-slab equivalents sit in the descriptor array returned by this+0x10 at word indices v4+17 and v4+49.
sub_58B130 is interpreted as free-list compaction per prior analysis; its exact contract is not independently verified here.
